test_title: PYST 43: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word.**

The crowds gathered were **__partisan__** in nature.
solution:
The correct answer is **biased**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym for the given word '**partisan**' is '**biased**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**partisan**' is '*a strong supporter of a party, cause, or person.*__'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Pitiful**- causing you to feel pity or sadness.
 
• **Kind**- caring about others; friendly and generous.
 
• **Destructive**- causing a lot of harm or damage.
